definitions.cost: 1 - actual similarity supplied to upstream assignment; BoT-SORT high/unconfirmed similarity is score-fused, weak stage is not. Not Mahalanobis, appearance, probability or a common cross-stage calibrated cost.
definitions.ambiguity: Chosen edge margin <=.05 to best other admissible edge in its row/column; can be negative. Alternatives can be assigned elsewhere.
definitions.promotion: Matched tentative hypothesis acquires a confirmed ID; instant first-frame births reported separately.
definitions.recovery: Confirmed retained hypothesis matched after >=1 fully missed frame; not proof of physical occlusion.
definitions.opportunity: Each frame/hypothesis with confirmed ID and >=1 prior miss at first-stage entry; correlated repeated opportunities, not unique people.
definitions.support: Current cache detection IoU >=.5 with last-known official-TP GT box; strong >=.6. Geometric support, not feasible one-to-one association or a causal detector diagnosis.

limitations: Previously studied MOT17 training previews, not independent acceptance or a held-out test.
GT is joined after tracking only; last official TP may itself follow an earlier identity error.
No intervention, threshold search, ReID, worker IPC timing, camera/3D/Windows/endurance acceptance.
public_scope: Reviewed aggregate counts/distributions and source hashes only. Matrices, cases, frames, IDs, exact events and local paths remain local.

stage_breakdown.method: Deterministic post-processing of frozen local traces/events, .05 margin; no new tracker run or control search. Competitor types can co-occur.
stage_breakdown.public_scope: Fixed stage/outcome/competitor labels and aggregate counts only; all source event identities stay local.

next_control_point.status: Research hypothesis only, not implemented or accepted
next_control_point.target: ByteTrack missed-frame recovery in weak_remaining, with a low-margin active-confirmed competing hypothesis. Preserve ordinary active-track weak updates and keep raw weak detections available.
next_control_point.risk: A blanket veto would also hit five same-GT recoveries in this observed cohort. Current TP/different previous GT is not automatically a counted IDSW or definitive physical identity error. No counterfactual score gain is claimed.
next_control_point.next_test: Freeze a separate deferred-reattachment/competition-aware recovery control, using only observable track state/history/cost at runtime. Compare FN/FP/IDSW/IDF1/HOTA and endpoint gains/losses on an independent licensed group before defaults.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not apply a global confirmation-cost cutoff: promotion TP/FP costs overlap and promotion ambiguity flags are zero.
Do not transfer the ByteTrack flag to BoT-SORT: its three ambiguous recoveries include two same-GT and zero FP.
No evidence for a residual-valid-edge repair here: all captured stages have zero eligible edges between both-unmatched endpoints.
Do not drop all weak detections, lengthen buffers blindly, or treat geometric support as a feasible assignment.
